Methodology: Lasso regression (α=0.9, 10-year window) maps 13 factor/style ETF ratios vs SPY to each FX rate. Residual = (actual − model) / actual × 100. Positive residual → currency overvalued relative to factor signals; negative → undervalued.
Factors: MTUM (Momentum), SPHB (High Beta), IWC (Micro Cap), IVW (LG Growth), IJT (SC Growth), IJR (Small Cap), IJS (SC Value), IJK (MC Growth), QUAL (Quality), IJJ (MC Value), VYM (High Div), IVE (LG Value), USMV (Min Vol).

AI Commentary · google/gemma-4-31B-it · 2026-07-14 21:32 UTC
Value and high-dividend factors proxy global risk appetite and real yield differentials; their strength typically signals a "risk-on" environment favoring carry-heavy EM currencies like BRL. A -10.4% residual indicates BRL is fundamentally overvalued relative to these equity drivers, suggesting the spot rate is being pushed lower by idiosyncratic local flows or temporary policy premiums not captured by global factor trends.
